name: alarm-actions
description: Alarm Actions - Home Assistant add-on that runs scripts before, at or after alarms

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
